purpose: Choose disjoint development and reserved confirmation CT windows before truth decode or any candidate inspection
support_predicate: fraction of CT pixels > 0 on source middle layer15 >= 0.60
development_selection: first qualifying origin in fixed row-major order
confirmation_selection: qualifying origin with maximal squared Euclidean distance from development origin; ties retain listed order; require separation>=768 pixels
qualification_limit: Same opened fragment; physically disjoint windows, no guarantee of ink and clean classes; no generalization or statistical independence implied
